nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set in Owned constructor and updated by acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address staged by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership (access control handover).
ERC20 token symbol, set to TSRN in the TessrnetToken constructor.
ERC20 token name, set to TESSRNET in the TessrnetToken constructor.
ERC20 token decimals, set to 8 in the TessrnetToken constructor.
Total token supply stored on-chain; assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of holder address to token balance; mutated by transfer() and transferFrom().
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance; mutated by approve(), transferFrom() and approveAndCall().
Pure checked addition helper used by transfer() and transferFrom(); reverts on overflow.
Pure checked subtraction helper used by transfer() and transferFrom(); reverts on underflow.
Pure checked multiplication helper; reverts on overflow.
Pure checked division helper; reverts on divide-by-zero.
Owned constructor that assigns owner from msg.sender, establishing the privileged role.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner address in newOwner.
Two-step ownership acceptance; requires msg.sender == newOwner then rewrites owner.
Deploys token metadata and mints the entire supply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
ERC20 transfer; debits msg.sender and credits recipient using SafeMath helpers.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens without double-spend protection.
Spends an allowance and moves tokens from a holder to a recipient using SafeMath helpers.
Returns the remaining allowance for a spender over a tokenOwner's balance.
Approves a spender then invokes spender.receiveApproval(...) in the same transaction, enabling callback reentrancy.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts so plain ETH transfers are rejected.
onlyOwner escape hatch that calls an arbitrary token contract's transfer(owner, tokens).
msg.sender used as the initial owner in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender used as the debited account and Transfer event emitter in transfer().
msg.sender used both as allowance owner and as the from argument forwarded to the spender callback.
msg.sender compared against newOwner in acceptOwnership() before ownership is transferred.
External call into attacker-controllable spender contract via receiveApproval after state is updated; classic callback/reentrancy surface.
External call to an arbitrary tokenAddress passed by the owner; guarded only by onlyOwner.
Addition c = a + b followed by require(c >= a); overflow-guarded arithmetic.
Subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a); underflow-guarded arithmetic.
Multiplication c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b); overflow-guarded arithmetic.
Division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0); divide-by-zero guarded arithmetic.

Allowance amount argument of approve(address spender, uint tokens).

Spender address argument of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender).
Spender contract address argument of approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data).
Allowance amount argument of approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data).

Token amount argument of transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens).

Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply(); can underflow if the zero address ever holds tokens.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable, granting privileged rights to the deployer.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before allowing an ownership change.
onlyOwner gates the privileged arbitrary-token transfer-out using msg.sender authorization.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before reassigning the owner role.
msg.sender indexes balances for the debit and is emitted in the Transfer event.
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping and is forwarded as the from argument to the callback.
The to parameter flows into balances[to] and the Transfer event.
The tokens parameter flows into safeSub/safeAdd to adjust balances.
The spender parameter indexes the allowed nested mapping.
The tokens parameter becomes the stored allowance value.
The from parameter is the debited holder account in transferFrom.
The to parameter is the credited recipient account in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is subtracted from both balance and allowance in transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the outer allowed mapping key.
The spender parameter indexes the inner allowed mapping key.
The spender parameter is cast to ApproveAndCallFallBack and called externally.
The tokens parameter is stored as allowance and forwarded to the callback.
The data parameter is passed unchanged into the external receiveApproval call.
The tokenAddress parameter determines which external contract is called.
The tokens parameter is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
The _newOwner parameter is staged into the newOwner state variable.
transfer writes the updated balances mapping for sender and recipient.
approve writes the allowance into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom adjusts balances for the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decrements the spender's allowance in the allowed mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried tokenOwner.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping for owner and spender.
approveAndCall stores the granted allowance before invoking the callback.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
The constructor writes the minted _totalSupply value.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears the newOwner state variable back to address(0).
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender with underflow protection.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient with overflow protection.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
safeAdd performs unchecked-addition semantics guarded by require(c >= a).
safeSub performs subtraction guarded by require(b <= a) to prevent underflow.
safeMul performs multiplication guarded by a round-trip division check.
safeDiv performs division guarded by require(b > 0).
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction that can underflow.
approveAndCall hands control to an untrusted spender contract through receiveApproval, enabling reentrant callbacks.
The reentered spender callback can invoke transfer/transferFrom on this token while the outer call is still executing.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes the external ERC20 transfer on an owner-supplied contract.
